reason: I already pay for ChatGPT and I'm not letting an AI answer my customers or touch my CRM on its own because a website says 'GDPR-compliant'. At most I'd poke at the free plan, but I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: If the AI support manager tells a customer something wrong, it's my name on it, and I don't know where my customer data goes, who processes it or what servers it sits on. 'Credits' also tells me nothing about what a month will really cost.
would_change_my_mind: A demo on my own inbox where every reply waits for my approval before it goes out, plus a signed data processing agreement with EU hosting and a Belgian or Dutch client of my size I can call.
